onboarding.title:
Bins out.
On time.
onboarding.body: Pickup reminders for your address in Vilnius district.
onboarding.featureReminder: Get a reminder the evening before
onboarding.disclaimer: Unofficial app made by volunteers. Dates come from the schedules published by UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“ and may contain mistakes.

setup.locationHint: Search for your village or town.
setup.locationNone: Nothing found. Only places served by UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“ are listed.
setup.manualLink: Can't find it? Pick schedule rows by hand
setup.streetHint: Pickup days in {{place}} depend on the street.
setup.housingHint: {{place}} has separate schedules for houses and apartment buildings.
setup.houseHint: Your own bin by the road
setup.chooseHint: Several rows mention {{place}}. Pick the one that includes your address.

select.title: {{kind}}: your area
select.hint: Search for your village, town or street, then pick the row that includes your address.
select.noResults: Nothing found. Try a shorter word, without the ending.
select.noDates: No exact dates in the schedule: {{note}}

home.nothingUpcoming: No upcoming pickups in the published schedule yet. We'll check for a new schedule automatically.
home.nothingForKind: No upcoming {{kind}} pickups in the published schedule.
home.placeMissing: Your place changed in the new schedule. Please choose it again.
home.choosePending: Tell us which {{kind}} schedule is yours.
home.noteOnly: {{kind}}: the schedule only says “{{note}}”, so we can't send reminders for it.
home.notificationsOff: Notifications are off, so you won't get reminders.
home.refreshFailed: Couldn't check for a new schedule. Showing the saved one.
